title: astragalus marianus
intro: Astragalus marianus, commonly known as Huangqi or Chinese Astragalus, is a perennial plant native to China and the Himalayas, belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include enhancing immune function, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus marianus include promoting diuresis, lowering blood pressure, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus marianus include isoflavones, saponins, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
